subject.title: fix(logging): keep JSON console output structured across CLI routes

question: Should this maintainer-owned PR become the canonical fix for the JSON console logging bug and supersede https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111908 after a current-main refresh?
rationale: Both PRs address the same concrete logging contract, but selecting the canonical landing branch is a maintainer ownership decision and this PR has the protected `maintainer` label.
